author: Scott Manley
description:
They can't harm you, if they can't find you! Use code MANLEY at the link below and get 60% off an annual plan: https://incogni.com/manley

The Space Shuttle was supposed to be so reusable that it could fly on a weekly basis, but it never got close to this, instead it became a lesson in what not to do when designing reusable spacecraft. And now, 50 years later SpaceX's Starship might actually fulfil the shuttle's dream of full and rapid reusability.
